guide.title: How to Export Reports
guide.description: This guide will walk you through the steps to find the analytics section of the application and export your reports.
steps: From the welcome screen, select 'Action Manager'.
Navigate to the 'Analytics' tab within the Action Manager.
Locate and click on the 'Export Reports' option to begin your download.
